description:
Listed Building Consent for the:
Repair and retention of all original windows with a secondary glazing system to all of the Almshouses
Replacement of all uPVC windows to match the original windows
Removal of hard cementitious mortar to the Almshouses in the re-pointing to match the original mortar composition and pointing finish
Replacement of the aluminium framed windows to the Community Hall and reinstatement of the original style
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good for the retained fabric, shall match the original work in type, colour, texture, profile and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, including facebond and pointing.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Cover Letter, Heritage Statement, Specification for removal of weatherstruck pointing, Planning Fire Safety Strategy, 20160/1000, 20160/1001, 20160/1002, 20160/1003, 20160/2000, 20160/2001, 20160/2002, 20160/2003, 20160/3000, 20160/3001, 20160/3002, 20160/3003, 20160/3004, 20160/3005, 20160/3006, 20160/3007, Location and Block Plan, EJJ Story - received 22nd June 2023.
